caption: The drawing features a detailed depiction of a metallic object with a turned and ornate vertical stem that gradually widens toward the base, set on three elegantly curved legs ending in ball-shaped feet, and topped with a rounded, pointed finial. The main object is shaded in gold and brown tones, giving a sense of volume and metallic sheen. To the left of the colored rendering, there is a line drawing of the same object, shown in gray outline with a scale in inches provided beneath it. Both depictions are enclosed within a thin rectangular border. The artist’s name, "Hans Korsch," appears in the lower right corner inside the border. The background is a plain, off-white paper with no additional decorations or objects.
title: Andiron (one of pair)
cluster: #16 — Lighting Devices: Lamps, Lanterns, and Candleholders
